question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fraction**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let us understand the meaning of the correct word:

__
 
• **Fraction**: a **small part** or amount; a division of a number.

 
 
• Example: *I believed the aircraft was going to explode for a fraction of a second.*
 
• Example: *Before answering, she paused for a fraction of a second.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the **correctly** spelt word out of the given options is "**fraction**".
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *Fraction*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Some of the synonyms of the correctly spelt word "fraction" is:

 
• Small part
 
• **Fragment**
 
• Snippet
 
• Snatch
 
• **Little**
 
• Bit
 
• **Trifle**
 
• Scrap
